purpose: Offline synthetic comparison of browse-tool's Readability plus Turndown extraction with Scrapling parser-only Markdown and optional adaptive selection.
provenance: All fixtures are synthetic, authored for this benchmark on 2026-10-16. They contain no copied private or third-party prose.

frozen_configuration.adaptive: Selector(adaptive=true, SQLite state) learns the listed CSS selector from BEFORE with auto_save=true; AFTER invokes that same now-missing selector with adaptive=true, auto_save=false, percentage=70. Selected subtree is converted by the incumbent Turndown path to isolate selection from Markdown formatting.

required: A small check before a big change
cases.notes: After moves the article below a wrapper and adds a related-story decoy.
After changes the main element and code-wrapper class, preserving code content.
After wraps the report in a grid and adds a sidebar table decoy.
Adaptive target is one record, not the full listing; AFTER changes its id and nests it, while retaining an intentionally similar intern decoy.

required: Nested layouts need a stable content boundary
Keep the decision with its evidence
cases.notes: After moves the target from an aside-adjacent column into a dialog-like section and leaves two non-target notes.
AFTER removes the learned target entirely and retains two structurally similar non-target plan cards. Any selected content is a false relocation.
